runId.description: The run the projection belongs to.

pinnedVersionId.description:
The content-addressed version id the run was bound to, or null when the
run never admitted against a procedure (unpinned default).

procedureKey.description: Stable key of the procedure the run rides, or null when unpinned.

pinnedAt.description: When the pin was recorded (UTC, ISO 8601).

eventCount.description: How many events the trace carries.

nodeId.description: The graph node (or version id for a pin event) the event relates to.

eventType.description: planned / started / completed / failed / gate_opened / gate_resolved / generation_opened / generation_exhausted / late_result / pin_recorded.

at.description: When the event was recorded (UTC, ISO 8601).

items.description: One trace event in the wire shape.

oneOf.description: Drift verdict between the compiled plan and the observed execution, or null.

isWithinPolicy.description: True when the observed drift stayed inside the declared tolerance.

description:
Response DTO for `GET /api/v1/procedures/runs/{runId}/live` —
the dashboard's Live run mode reads this to render the pinned-version
chrome, the path, and the drift verdict. Composed server-side from
the run's planned-vs-observed trace; the trace carries the pin
metadata (version, procedure key, project id, pinned at) seeded at
admission, so the projection is a single read. Null fields render
at an empty state in Studio, not an HTTP error.
